senses.gloss:
उष् 1. उष्, cl. 1. P. ओषति, औषत्, उवोष
or ओषाञ्-चकार, ओषिष्यति, औषीत्, ओषि-
तुम्, to burn; to punish; to consume; to kill, injure:
Caus. ओषयति, -यितुम्: Desid. ओषिषिषति; [cf.
Lat. uro, ustus; Gr. αὔω, αὖος Hib. usga, ‘incense.’]

उष् 2. उष् (connected with rt. 3. वस्, to
shine; used as a noun but only in the form उषस्),
Ved. light, morning, dawn; उषस् तिस्रः, morning,
midday, and evening. (The words उषस् and उषा
below are connected by native authorities with 1. उष्.)

ऊष् ऊष्, cl. 1. P. ऊषति, -षितुम्, to be
diseased or disordered, to be sick or ill.
